prompt: Aynı müşterinin birden fazla şikayeti var mı? (top tekrar eden müşteriler)
sql_text: SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) AS complaints_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT flight_number) AS distinct_flights FROM complaints WHERE date(created_at) >= date('now','-30 day') GROUP BY customer_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY complaints_cnt DESC, distinct_flights DESC LIMIT 20;

SELECT date(created_at) AS day, category, COUNT(*) AS complaints_cnt FROM complaints WHERE date(created_at) >= date('now','-30 day') AND category IN ('delay','baggage','service') GROUP BY day, category ORDER BY day, category;
SELECT strftime('%w', created_at) AS dow, COUNT(*) AS complaints_cnt FROM complaints WHERE date(created_at) >= date('now','-30 day') GROUP BY dow ORDER BY complaints_cnt DESC;

prompt: Kategori bazında benzersiz müşteri/şikayet oranı nedir?
sql_text: WITH base AS ( SELECT category, COUNT(*) AS complaints_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS unique_customers FROM complaints WHERE date(created_at) >= date('now','-30 day') GROUP BY category ) SELECT category, complaints_cnt, unique_customers, ROUND(1.0*complaints_cnt / NULLIF(unique_customers,0), 2) AS complaints_per_customer FROM base ORDER BY complaints_per_customer DESC, complaints_cnt DESC;

prompt: Son 30 günde weather_impact=1 uçuşlarda; kategoriye göre şikayet sayısı, müşteri sayısı ve refund oranı nedir?
prompt_norm: weather impact şikayet kategori refund oran
sql_text: WITH wx_flights AS ( SELECT DISTINCT flight_number FROM flights WHERE weather_impact = 1 AND delay_minutes > 0 AND date(departure_time) >= date('now','-30 day') ), comp AS ( SELECT c.category, c.flight_number, COUNT(*) AS complaint_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_id) AS comp_customers FROM complaints c JOIN wx_flights f USING (flight_number) WHERE date(c.created_at) >= date('now','-30 day') GROUP BY c.category, c.flight_number ), ref AS ( SELECT r.flight_number, COUNT(DISTINCT r.customer_id) AS refunded_customers FROM refunds r JOIN wx_flights f USING (flight_number) GROUP BY r.flight_number ), joined AS ( SELECT comp.category, comp.flight_number, comp.complaint_cnt, comp.comp_customers, COALESCE(ref.refunded_customers,0) AS refunded_customers FROM comp LEFT JOIN ref USING (flight_number) ) SELECT category, SUM(complaint_cnt) AS total_complaints, SUM(comp_customers) AS customers_with_complaints, SUM(refunded_customers) AS refunded_customers, ROUND(100.0*SUM(refunded_customers)/NULLIF(SUM(comp_customers),0),2) AS refund_rate_pct FROM joined GROUP BY category ORDER BY total_complaints DESC LIMIT 10;

prompt: Son 30 günde en çok şikayete sahip kategori hangisi? Bu kategorideki uçuşların toplam gecikmesi kaç dakika?
sql_text: WITH top_cat AS ( SELECT category FROM complaints WHERE date(created_at) >= date('now','-30 day') GROUP BY category ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1 ), flt AS ( SELECT DISTINCT c.flight_number FROM complaints c JOIN top_cat t ON t.category = c.category WHERE date(c.created_at) >= date('now','-30 day') ) SELECT SUM(f.delay_minutes) AS total_delay_minutes FROM flights f JOIN flt USING (flight_number) WHERE date(f.departure_time) >= date('now','-30 day');

prompt: Son 14 günde hava kaynaklı gecikmesi olan uçuşlar: en çok etkilenen ilk 10 uçuş (toplam ve ortalama gecikme).
sql_text: SELECT flight_number, COUNT(*) AS affected_flights, SUM(delay_minutes) AS total_delay_minutes, ROUND(AVG(delay_minutes),2) AS avg_delay_minutes FROM flights WHERE weather_impact = 1 AND delay_minutes > 0 AND date(departure_time) >= date('now','-14 day') GROUP BY flight_number ORDER BY total_delay_minutes DESC LIMIT 10;

prompt: Son 30 günde crew_issues=1 olan uçuşların şikayet kategori dağılımı ve toplam gecikmesi; crew_issues=0 ile kıyasla.
prompt_norm: crew issues uçuş şikayet gecikme kıyas
sql_text: WITH flt AS ( SELECT flight_number, crew_issues FROM flights WHERE date(departure_time) >= date('now','-30 day') ), comp AS ( SELECT c.category, f.crew_issues, COUNT(*) AS complaints_cnt FROM complaints c JOIN flt f USING (flight_number) WHERE date(c.created_at) >= date('now','-30 day') GROUP BY c.category, f.crew_issues ), del AS ( SELECT crew_issues, SUM(delay_minutes) AS total_delay FROM flights WHERE date(departure_time) >= date('now','-30 day') GROUP BY crew_issues ) SELECT comp.category, comp.crew_issues, comp.complaints_cnt, COALESCE(d.total_delay,0) AS total_delay FROM comp LEFT JOIN del d USING (crew_issues) ORDER BY comp.complaints_cnt DESC;

prompt: A320 filosu: weather/non_weather gecikme dağılımı ve en çok geciken 5 uçuş.
prompt_norm: a320 weather gecikme dağılım top 5 uçuş
sql_text: WITH a320 AS ( SELECT flight_number, delay_minutes, weather_impact FROM flights WHERE aircraft_type = 'A320' AND date(departure_time) >= date('now','-30 day') ), agg AS ( SELECT CASE WHEN weather_impact=1 THEN 'weather' ELSE 'non_weather' END AS delay_cause, COUNT(*) AS flights_cnt, SUM(delay_minutes) AS total_delay FROM a320 GROUP BY delay_cause ), top5 AS ( SELECT flight_number, SUM(delay_minutes) AS total_delay FROM a320 GROUP BY flight_number ORDER BY total_delay DESC LIMIT 5 ) SELECT 'CAUSE_SUMMARY' AS section, delay_cause, flights_cnt, total_delay, NULL AS flight_number FROM agg UNION ALL SELECT 'TOP5_FLIGHTS' AS section, NULL, NULL, total_delay, flight_number FROM top5;
